author: Mooch24
body:
Heyo! So recently I've been having some computer troubles so I've been forced to work in singleplayer or a server with at most 5 players. I figured in the mean time, I'd make a map :P

Important Note: This map is not completely finished. I'd love for some suggestions from the community :)

Huge thanks to AdrianG503 and Storm997 :D

Here's the album: http://imgur.com/a/TP4aD#0
